items.name: Export to Banner Award Extraction
items.description: Uploads a fully-executed federal award document (notice of award, cooperative agreement, contract, or modification) and returns a single structured JSON object covering the six blocks needed to populate the VERAS Export to Banner form: award identification (FAIN, title, PI, type, pass-through, CFDA, NAICS, agency); dates and performance period (current and overall, plus multi-year periods table); sponsor entity classification (entity type, agency hierarchy, address, UEIs); budget structure (line-item categories with JSON-number amounts, F&A rate / base, cost share, program income); billing and payment terms (type enum, frequency, PMS LOC code, payment terms); and reporting / special requirements (reports table, record retention, carry-forward, prior-approval, closeout, governing regs). Output conforms to the export-to-banner-extraction-udm component schema. The runtime mirrors the ui-insight/ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow's six parallel Extraction tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt.

data.name: extract-award-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting the AWARD IDENTIFICATION block of a
fully-executed federal award document. Mirrors TASK-01 of the
source ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow.

Be 100% accurate. Quote identifiers verbatim. Use null for
fields the document does not state.

For award_type pick exactly one of the four enum values
(Grant, Cooperative Agreement, Contract, Subcontract).

is_pass_through is a JSON boolean. When true, populate
prime_sponsor_name with the prime sponsor's full name. When
false, prime_sponsor_name is null.

cfda_number uses the document's stated XX.XXX format. When
multiple CFDAs apply, comma-separate them as a single string.

items.searchphrase: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN) or sponsor award number.
items.title: award_number

items.searchphrase: Full project title as stated in the award document.
items.title: project_title

items.searchphrase: Principal Investigator name as listed on the award.
items.title: pi_name

items.searchphrase: Award type classification (Grant, Cooperative Agreement, Contract, Subcontract).
items.title: award_type

items.searchphrase: Whether the award is a pass-through (subaward) or a direct federal award as a JSON boolean.
items.title: is_pass_through

items.searchphrase: Name of the prime sponsor for pass-through awards; null for direct federal awards.
items.title: prime_sponsor_name

items.searchphrase: Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) / Assistance Listing number in XX.XXX format.
items.title: cfda_number

items.searchphrase: North American Industry Classification System code from the award header.
items.title: naics_code

items.searchphrase: Name of the federal awarding agency.
items.title: federal_agency_name

data.name: extract-dates-and-performance
data.prompt:
You are extracting the DATES AND PERFORMANCE PERIOD block of a
fully-executed federal award document. Mirrors TASK-02 of the
source ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow.

Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD when the document is unambiguous.
When the document gives a qualitative form
(e.g., "5 years from acceptance"), preserve the document's
stated form as a string. Do not invent precision.

award_start_date / award_end_date are the current budget
period. performance_period_start / performance_period_end are
the overall project period (may extend beyond the current
budget period for multi-year incremental awards).

budget_periods is a JSON array of
{period_number, start_date, end_date, amount} objects, one row
per budget period when the award is incrementally funded.
Empty array when the award is a single-period award.

is_multi_year is true / false / null (null when not
determinable).

items.searchphrase: Start date of the current award or budget period in ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous.
items.title: award_start_date

items.searchphrase: End date of the current award or budget period in ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous.
items.title: award_end_date

items.searchphrase: Start date of the overall project performance period in ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous.
items.title: performance_period_start

items.searchphrase: End date of the overall project performance period in ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous.
items.title: performance_period_end

items.searchphrase: Budget period rows as a JSON array of {period_number, start_date, end_date, amount} objects when multi-year incremental; empty array otherwise.
items.title: budget_periods

items.searchphrase: Whether the award spans multiple budget periods with incremental funding as a JSON boolean.
items.title: is_multi_year

data.name: extract-sponsor-and-entity
data.prompt:
You are extracting the SPONSOR AND ENTITY CLASSIFICATION block
of a fully-executed federal award document. Mirrors TASK-03 of
the source ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow.

sponsor_entity_type picks exactly one of the seven enum values
(Federal, State Government, Non-Profit, Private Industry,
Foundation, University, Other).

sponsor_uei / awardee_uei are 12-character alphanumeric
strings when stated. Preserve case verbatim. Null when not
stated in the document.

items.searchphrase: Full legal name of the sponsoring organization.
items.title: sponsor_name

items.searchphrase: Sponsor entity classification (Federal, State Government, Non-Profit, Private Industry, Foundation, University, Other).
items.title: sponsor_entity_type

items.searchphrase: Full agency hierarchy (e.g., USDA > NIFA > Agriculture and Food Research Initiative).
items.title: federal_agency_hierarchy

items.searchphrase: Sponsor mailing or billing address as stated in the award document.
items.title: sponsor_address

items.searchphrase: Sponsor Unique Entity Identifier as a 12-character alphanumeric string.
items.title: sponsor_uei

items.searchphrase: Name of the recipient institution as stated in the award.
items.title: awardee_organization

items.searchphrase: Awardee Unique Entity Identifier as a 12-character alphanumeric string.
items.title: awardee_uei

data.name: extract-budget-and-financial
data.prompt:
You are extracting the BUDGET AND FINANCIAL TERMS block of a
fully-executed federal award document. Mirrors TASK-04 of the
source ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow.

CRITICAL: All monetary fields are JSON NUMBERS, not quoted
strings. Convert document language verbatim to numeric values:
  "$1,234,567.89" -> 1234567.89
  "$500,000"      -> 500000

Numeric fields: total_award_amount, total_anticipated_amount,
total_direct_costs, total_indirect_costs, cost_share_amount,
budget_categories[].approved_amount.

fa_rate is a STRING with the document's percentage notation
(e.g., "56.5%", "30% MTDC"). fa_rate_base picks exactly one of
MTDC, TDC, "Salary & Wages", Other, or null when the document
does not state it.

budget_categories is a JSON array of
{category, approved_amount} objects, one entry per sponsor
category. category is the exact label (e.g., "Salary",
"Fringe", "Equipment", "Travel", "Operating/Supplies",
"Subcontracts", "Other"). approved_amount is a JSON number.

is_fa_waived is true when indirect costs are waived or
limited; false when the negotiated rate applies; null when not
determinable.

items.searchphrase: Total amount of the current award action as a JSON number.
items.title: total_award_amount

items.searchphrase: Total anticipated funding across all periods as a JSON number; null when not specified.
items.title: total_anticipated_amount

items.searchphrase: Budget breakdown by sponsor category as a JSON array of {category, approved_amount} objects with approved_amount as JSON number.
items.title: budget_categories

items.searchphrase: Total direct costs as a JSON number; null when not specified.
items.title: total_direct_costs

items.searchphrase: Total indirect (F&A) costs as a JSON number; null when not specified.
items.title: total_indirect_costs

items.searchphrase: Facilities & Administrative (indirect cost) rate as a percentage string with base annotation (e.g., 56.5%, 30% MTDC).
items.title: fa_rate

items.searchphrase: F&A rate base type (MTDC, TDC, Salary & Wages, Other) or null when not specified.
items.title: fa_rate_base

items.searchphrase: Whether indirect costs are waived or limited by the sponsor as a JSON boolean.
items.title: is_fa_waived

items.searchphrase: Required cost-sharing or matching amount as a JSON number; null when not applicable.
items.title: cost_share_amount

items.searchphrase: Type of cost sharing (mandatory, voluntary committed, in-kind) as a string.
items.title: cost_share_type

items.searchphrase: Program income provisions and handling requirements.
items.title: program_income

data.name: extract-billing-and-payment
data.prompt:
You are extracting the BILLING AND PAYMENT TERMS block of a
fully-executed federal award document. Mirrors TASK-05 of the
source ProcessMapping export-to-banner-extraction workflow.

billing_type picks exactly one of the four enum values
(Cost Reimbursement, Fixed Price, Letter of Credit, Milestone).

billing_frequency is a string (Monthly, Quarterly,
Upon Milestone, etc.). Preserve the document's wording.

invoice_requirements is a JSON array of strings (one per
required item). Empty array when none specified.

final_invoice_deadline preserves the document's wording
(e.g., "60 days", "90 days after project end"). String.

items.searchphrase: Type of billing arrangement (Cost Reimbursement, Fixed Price, Letter of Credit, Milestone).
items.title: billing_type

items.searchphrase: How often invoices should be submitted (Monthly, Quarterly, Upon Milestone).
items.title: billing_frequency

items.searchphrase: Physical or electronic address for invoice submission.
items.title: billing_address

items.searchphrase: Email address for electronic invoice submission.
items.title: invoice_email

items.searchphrase: Payment Management System or Letter of Credit code for federal drawdowns.
items.title: pms_loc_code

items.searchphrase: Payment terms (e.g., Net 30, advance payment, reimbursement).
items.title: payment_terms

items.searchphrase: Items required on invoices as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: invoice_requirements

items.searchphrase: Deadline for submitting the final invoice after project end.
items.title: final_invoice_deadline

items.searchphrase: Name and contact information for the sponsor's billing or payment office.
items.title: billing_contact

data.name: extract-reporting-and-special
data.prompt:
You are extracting the REPORTING AND SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS
block of a fully-executed federal award document. Mirrors
TASK-06 of the source ProcessMapping
export-to-banner-extraction workflow.

reporting_requirements is a JSON array of
{report_type, frequency, due_date_or_timing, submission_method}
objects. One entry per required report.

prior_approval_requirements, special_terms, and
governing_regulations are JSON arrays of strings. Empty arrays
when not specified.

record_retention_period, carry_forward_policy, and
closeout_requirements are strings or null.

items.searchphrase: Required reports as a JSON array of {report_type, frequency, due_date_or_timing, submission_method} objects.
items.title: reporting_requirements

items.searchphrase: Required record retention period (e.g., 3 years after final FFR).
items.title: record_retention_period

items.searchphrase: Whether unspent funds can be carried forward to subsequent budget periods and under what conditions.
items.title: carry_forward_policy

items.searchphrase: Actions requiring prior written agency approval as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: prior_approval_requirements

items.searchphrase: Special terms and conditions beyond standard federal requirements as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: special_terms

items.searchphrase: Specific closeout requirements and timeline.
items.title: closeout_requirements

items.searchphrase: Governing regulations and terms referenced as a JSON array of strings.
items.title: governing_regulations

data.name: export-to-banner-extraction-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Export to Banner Award
Extraction workflow. You receive six extraction outputs from
the previous step (award_identification, dates_and_performance,
sponsor_entity, budget_financial, billing_payment,
reporting_special) and must emit a SINGLE JSON object that
validates against the export-to-banner-extraction-udm@0.1.0
schema (schema.json in the component directory).

## Output contract

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no closing commentary,
no markdown fences. If your runtime requires fenced output, wrap
in a single ```json ... ``` block and emit nothing outside it.

Top-level keys (in this order): `award_identification`,
`dates_and_performance`, `sponsor_entity`, `budget_financial`,
`billing_payment`, `reporting_special`.

## Field-by-field assembly

Pass the six extraction fragments through into the six
top-level blocks. Apply the following normalizations.

### award_identification

Required (must not be null): award_number, project_title,
pi_name, award_type (one of the four enum values),
is_pass_through (JSON boolean), federal_agency_name.

prime_sponsor_name is null when is_pass_through is false.

### dates_and_performance

Required: award_start_date, award_end_date,
performance_period_start, performance_period_end. Use ISO
YYYY-MM-DD when the document is unambiguous.

budget_periods is required by the schema as an array. Empty
array for single-period awards.

### sponsor_entity

Required: sponsor_name, sponsor_entity_type (one of the seven
enum values), awardee_organization.

### budget_financial

Required: total_award_amount (JSON number),
budget_categories (array of {category, approved_amount}
objects with approved_amount as JSON number).

CRITICAL: If any extractor surfaced a quoted dollar string
(e.g., "$1,234,567.89"), convert it to a JSON number
(1234567.89) here. Apply to total_award_amount,
total_anticipated_amount, total_direct_costs,
total_indirect_costs, cost_share_amount, every
budget_categories[].approved_amount, every
budget_periods[].amount.

fa_rate remains a string. fa_rate_base picks one of MTDC, TDC,
"Salary & Wages", Other, or null.

### billing_payment

Required: billing_type (one of the four enum values).

invoice_requirements is required by the schema as an array.
Empty array when none specified.

### reporting_special

Required: reporting_requirements (array of objects).

prior_approval_requirements, special_terms,
governing_regulations are required by the schema as arrays.
Empty array when none specified.

## Cross-field rules (from source workflow)

1. CFR-01 (error): award_start_date < award_end_date.
   When the document violates this, do not alter the dates —
   append a flag string to reporting_special.special_terms:
   "FLAG: award_start_date is not before award_end_date in
   the source document."

2. CFR-02 (warning): performance_period_start <=
   award_start_date. When the document violates this,
   do not alter the dates — append a flag string to
   reporting_special.special_terms:
   "FLAG: performance_period_start is later than
   award_start_date in the source document."

## Quality bar

- Output validates against schema.json (draft 2020-12).
- award_type, sponsor_entity_type, fa_rate_base, and
  billing_type are exact enum matches.
- All monetary fields are JSON numbers.
- Booleans are JSON booleans.
- Dates use ISO YYYY-MM-DD when unambiguous.
- Required arrays (budget_categories, budget_periods,
  invoice_requirements, reporting_requirements,
  prior_approval_requirements, special_terms,
  governing_regulations) are always emitted; use [] when
  empty rather than null.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify award_start_date < award_end_date and performance_period_start <= award_start_date.
Verify monetary amounts are emitted as JSON numbers, not quoted strings.
Verify UEI follows the 12-character alphanumeric format when present.
Verify cfda_number follows the XX.XXX format when present.
